label: c/3/d/l input at original positions 2-5
explanation: Fires only in the original (input) phase, essentially never at the delimiter or during copy, and never at t=0,1 or t>=7. Peaks at t=3 (47% of mass), then t=4 and t=2, falling off by t=5-6. It is driven by the current input token: c (35% of mass), 3 (28%), d (17%) and l (12%), with weaker firing on 2, v and x. The predicate (input c/3/d/l at t=2..5) covers 91% of activation mass on dev, but precision is only about 0.24, so most such steps stay below threshold. Context modulates whether it fires: rate is much higher when the sequence begins with r, j, k or z (a first-token filter roughly doubles precision but halves recall). It fires mainly on the first occurrence of the token (in_first=1 holds 87% of mass). Top activations are c or 3 at t=3 after a first token of r or j. It is not sensitive to output tokens or copy state.
